title: Meiyazhagan
desc: Arul visits his hometown for a wedding. He meets a relative whose kindness helps him reconnect with forgotten family ties and precious memories.

title: Anjani Putra
desc: A businessman saves a policeman from a group of thugs. As a result, he incurs the wrath of a ruthless local gangster who is also an assassin.

title: Mookuthi Amman
desc: The life of struggling news anchor, Engels Ramaswamy, and his family changes when a goddess appears before them. Later, with the help of the goddess, Engels sets out to expose fake godmen.

title: Finder -- Project 1
desc: A pair of criminology graduates start a firm to prove the innocence of people wrongly framed and punished for criminal offences.

title: Thiruppu Munai
desc: A politician plots against his rival for a ministerial post. Meanwhile, a jobless graduate seeking work gets entangled in the scheme and faces grave consequences, leading to a fight for justice.

title: Ghajinikanth
desc: Rajnikanth, a man suffering from selective amnesia, meets the woman of his dreams and attempts to hide his condition from her.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Sakka Podu Podu Raja
desc: Santa turns Bhavani, a gangster, into his enemy after helping his friend elope with the thug's sister. Later, Santa falls in love with a girl, who turns out to be Bhavani's younger sister.

title: Kadavul Irukaan Kumaru
desc: Kumar and his friend decide to celebrate the former's bachelor's party before his wedding. However, chaos ensues when the duo are caught by the police for carrying alcohol.

title: Supreme
desc: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Rum
desc: After a heist, Shiva and his crew hide out in an abandoned bungalow. However, they are soon haunted by spooky occurrences.

title: Hit List
desc: Vijay's life turns into a living hell when a mysterious masked figure abducts his family. Forced into a dark world of violence, he becomes an unwilling assassin, targeting the kidnapper's enemies.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.
